context_for_next_agent: FEATURE: การจองคิวนัดหมาย (appointment slot booking) + แจ้งเตือนนัดหมาย (reminders) for the LINE OA. User decisions locked at intake: (1) standalone service booking, NOT linked to service_requests; (2) time slots with a per-slot quota, derived from the existing business_hours table; (3) notifications = immediate LINE confirmation + Telegram alert to staff + Flex reply when a citizen asks about their queue; (4) advance reminder is ADMIN-CONFIGURABLE - on/off toggle plus a lead value with unit DAY or HOUR (the user explicitly asked for this rather than a hardcoded 1-day reminder); (5) auto-confirm, no staff approval step. KEY DISCOVERY: this is NOT greenfield - app/models/booking.py and the bookings table already exist and are live in production (created by the initial migration 1349087a4a24) with id/user_id/service_type/booking_date/booking_time/queue_number/status/created_at, plus User.bookings at models/user.py:75. Nothing else references it: no service, no endpoint, no UI. So T1 EXTENDS an existing production table - it does not create one. REUSE MAP (all internal, no new pip dependency is proposed - APScheduler was considered and rejected because app/tasks/ already provides the mechanism and APScheduler would not solve the multi-worker problem either): tasks/broadcast_scheduler.py is the template for the reminder loop (asyncio loop started from the main.py lifespan, polls every 30s); SettingsService.get_setting/set_setting (services/settings_service.py) is a plain key-value store over system_settings and holds all booking config; telegram_service.send_alert_message(text, db) is the generic staff alert; message_intake/commands.py handle_check_status is the exact template for the Flex queue-status reply (routed from message_handler.py:123 on text equality); flex_messages.py currently has only build_request_status_list. TWO CORRECTNESS HAZARDS THE PLAN EXISTS TO CLOSE - do not lose these: (H1) slot oversell - count-then-insert is unsafe because SELECT FOR UPDATE locks existing rows and cannot block a concurrent INSERT into the same slot (phantom row), so two citizens both pass the capacity check for the last seat; fix is pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext(service_type|date|time)) taken at the top of the booking transaction, with the count, capacity check, queue-number allocation and insert all inside it. (H2) duplicate reminders - production runs 2 uvicorn workers so each has its own scheduler loop; SKIP LOCKED narrows but does not close the window, so the real guard must be a claim: UPDATE bookings SET reminder_sent_at=now() WHERE id=:id AND reminder_sent_at IS NULL, and push only when rowcount==1. DELIBERATE DESIGN CALLS made on the user's behalf, flagged to them at Gate 1 and open to override: no line_user_id column on bookings (resolve the push target through the user relationship via resolve_raw_for_push, because adding a plaintext LINE ID column now cuts against the in-flight pseudonymisation work); config lives in system_settings keys rather than new tables; booking_blackout_dates was added because business_hours only models day-of-week and without it citizens can book public holidays; cancel-and-rebook instead of reschedule; a notification failure must never roll back a confirmed booking but must still be logged. MIGRATION RULE inherited from PR #183 - declare indexes in __table_args__ under the names production actually uses, never index=True, and confirm with `python scripts/db_target.py alembic --target remote check` printing 'No new upgrade operations detected'. TESTING GOTCHA still applies: locally ~739 tests pass because the 60 DB-backed tests silently error without Postgres+Redis; CI runs the full set.
